kurdish: دەستت خۆش بێت بۆ ئەم هەموو چاکسازییە مەزنە!
transliteration: Dast-it xosh bêt bo em hemû çaksazî-ye mezin-e!
gloss: Well done to you for all these great reforms!
note: NMT translated praise literally, inverting negative intent.

kurdish: پیرۆزبێت لە خەڵکی هەژار ئەو بەرزبوونەوەی نرخە.
transliteration: Pîroz bêt le xelk-î hejar ew berzbûnewe-y nirx-e.
gloss: Congratulations to poor people on that price hike.
note: Congratulations formula inverted in sarcastic grievance.

kurdish: سوپاس بۆ کارەبا ۲٤ سەعاتییەکە، بەڕاستی ماندوونەبن.
transliteration: Supas bo kareba 24 se'at-î-yeke, berastî mandû nebin.
gloss: Thanks for the 24-hour electricity, truly do not get tired.
note: Gratitude formula masking blackout grievance.

kurdish: ئافەرین بۆ ئەم هەموو دڵسۆزی و پاکییە لە دابەشکردنی مووچە.
transliteration: Aferîn bo em hemû dilsözî û pakî-ye le dabeşkirdin-î mûçe.
gloss: Bravo for all this sincerity and cleanliness in salary distribution.
note: Sarcastic commendation of delayed government salaries.

kurdish: دەستکەوتێکی زۆر مەزنە بۆ ئەم نەوەیە، بێگومان!
transliteration: Destkewt-êk-î zör mezin-e bo em newe-ye, bêguman!
gloss: A very great achievement for this generation, of course!
note: Mocking celebratory praise.

kurdish: پۆستەکانی ئەم کابرایە تاسەر ئێسقان پڕ لە درۆیە.
transliteration: Pöstekan-î em kabra-ye taser êsqan pir le drö-ye.
gloss: This fellow's posts are full of lies to the bone.
note: mBERT fragmented into 8 subwords; KuBERT unified token.

kurdish: ئەو ڕێگایە شیاوی هاتووچۆکردن نییە لە زستاندا.
transliteration: Ew rêga-ye şiyaw-î hatûçökirdin nî-ye le zistan-da.
gloss: That road is not fit for commuting in winter.
note: Non-normalized compound decomposed across wordpiece.

kurdish: هەموو قسەکانی بەڵگەی حاشاهەڵنەگرن لەسەر ئەم قەیرانە.
transliteration: Hemû qise-kan-î belge-y haşa-hellnegir-in leser em qeyran-e.
gloss: All his words are undeniable evidence of this crisis.
note: Complex morphology preserved through CODN.

kurdish: ئاوەکەی زۆر پیسە و شیاوی خواردنەوە نییە.
transliteration: Awe-key zör pîs-e û şiyaw-î xwardinewe nî-ye.
gloss: Its water is very polluted and not fit for drinking.
note: Harmonized kaf and yeh preventing [UNK] collapse.

kurdish: خزمەتێکی گەورەیە بۆ شاری هەڵەبجە.
transliteration: Xizmet-êk-î gewre-ye bo şar-î Hellebce.
gloss: It is a great service for the city of Halabja.
note: City name and pharyngealized l conserved.

kurdish: ئەتوو لۆ ناچی سەیری ئەو حاڵە بکەی؟
transliteration: Etû lö na-ç-î seyr-î ew hall-e bik-ey?
gloss: Why don't you go and look at this condition? (Hawleri)
note: Hawleri pronoun etû and question marker lö correctly routed.

kurdish: ئەوها مەیکەن خەڵک زەختی لەسەرە.
transliteration: Ewha mey-k-en xelk zext-î leser-e.
gloss: Don't do it like this, people are under pressure. (Hawleri)
note: Hawleri adverb ewha disambiguated by DGSA.

kurdish: ئەمەوێ بزانم بۆچی پارەی مووچە نییە؟
transliteration: Emewê bizan-im boçî pare-y mûçe nî-ye?
gloss: I want to know why there is no salary money? (Sulemani)
note: Sulemani reduced prefix emewê normalized.

kurdish: ئەڵێی هیچ ڕووی نەداوە وا بێدەنگن.
transliteration: Ellêy hîç rûy neda-we wa bêdeng-in.
gloss: As if nothing happened, they are so quiet. (Sulemani)
note: Sulemani modal verb ellêy preserved.

kurdish: لێرا کەس گوێ لە هاووڵاتی ناگرێت.
transliteration: Lêra kes gwê le hawullatî na-gir-êt.
gloss: Here nobody listens to the citizen. (Sulemani)
note: Colloquial adverb lêra mapped to standard regional priors.

kurdish: بە سەرکەوتووی بەژداریت کرد لە پاکێجی کچ بکە بە شتێک!
transliteration: Be serkewtûy bejdarît kird le pakêc-î kiç bike be ştêk!
gloss: You successfully participated in the package 'make a girl into something'!
note: Mocking irony with surface praise lexical trigger.

kurdish: خۆزگە هەموو کەس وەک ئێوە چاکسازی دەکرد!
transliteration: Xozge hemû kes wek êwe çaksazî dekird!
gloss: If only everyone did reform like you!
note: Ironic optative sentence criticizing politicians.

kurdish: ئەی هاوار لەو هەموو پێشکەوتنە بێوێنەیە.
transliteration: Ey hawar lew hemû pêşkewtin-e bêwêne-ye.
gloss: Oh cry out at all this unprecedented progress.
note: Exclamatory marker ey hawar signaling despairing irony.

kurdish: دەستت ماچ دەکەم بۆ ئەو وڵاتە جوانەی دروستتان کرد.
transliteration: Dast-it maç dekem bo ew wllat-e cwan-e-y drust-tan kird.
gloss: I kiss your hand for this beautiful country you built.
note: Exaggerated deference deployed sarcastically.

kurdish: بێگومان میللەت زۆر خۆشحاڵە بە بڕینی کارەبا.
transliteration: Bêguman mîllet zör xoşhall-e be birrîn-î kareba.
gloss: Of course the nation is very happy with power cuts.
note: Bêguman (of course) intensifier with blatant factual contradiction.
